review_evidence: README identifies this repository as the author's Lean solutions to Advent of Code 2021/2023/2024/2025; the 93 primary files were inventoried across solution modules, utilities, import roots, a source template and executable entry point.

Actual Advents modules contain nontrivial typed algorithms/data structures, and Advents/Utils.lean plus 2023 day02 variants contain checked theorem statements such as Prod.lt_iff and cols.le_def; these remain searchable rather than being rejected as programming examples.

.src/template.lean is only a YYYY/day placeholder with sorry stubs and commented assertion placeholders, while Main.lean only imports Advents and prints Hello; neither owns a completed problem solution or reusable formal result.

rules.content_invariant: The template is an uninstantiated YYYY/day skeleton with empty test data and sorry placeholders; Main.lean is only an import plus Hello IO entry point. All actual AoC algorithms, typed models, utility theorems and year import surfaces remain retained.
evidence: The actual Advents tree was inventoried and proposition-bearing utility/solution files were explicitly checked and retained.
rules.rationale: Remove exact authoring/executable scaffolding while retaining every instantiated Advent-of-Code solution and formal utility.

summary: Reviewed Advents; retain the Lean challenge solutions, utilities and theorem-bearing examples, excluding only the uninstantiated source template and trivial executable hello wrapper.
